verdict.rationale: Langfuse supports threshold-based alerts (Slack/GitHub Actions/Webhooks) and automated scoring of production traces via LLM-as-a-Judge, which are event-triggered automations, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rule-engine where arbitrary user-defined conditions trigger arbitrary custom actions across the platform. missing for 10: user-defined conditional rule builder, broader action types beyond notifications/scoring (e.g. auto-remediation, workflow triggers), independent confirmation of alerting reliability.
